name: In-Memory Biometric Vault Adapter
summary: In-memory AES-256-GCM encrypted credential vault with biometric authorization callback hooks
description:
## In-Memory Biometric Vault Adapter

Provides in-memory AES-256-GCM credential encryption gated by configurable biometric or user-presence authorization callback hooks. Designed as an adapter layer for applications connecting UI biometrics to ephemeral in-memory token vaults.

### Security Details
- Ephemeral in-memory storage; tokens do not persist across process restarts
- Enforces user-supplied master passphrase (min 8 characters)
- AES-256-GCM encryption with randomized salt and IV per entry
- Zero third-party dependencies
